name: Inline blade fuse holder with fuse
description: Blows before a short circuit can melt wires or start a fire. Goes right after the battery + terminal.
notes: Pick about 125 % of the maximum continuous current, but never more than the wire or the smallest part can carry.
Use a DC-rated fuse at or above your supply voltage (automotive blade fuses: 32 V DC).
The holder wire gauge must match the fuse rating.
